calls.statement:
SELECT s.format, COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
 ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id),4) atv,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN f.receipt_id END) nonpos_receipts,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.receipt_id END) test_receipts,
 COUNT(DISTINCT f.channel_code) chcodes
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT 'multi-store receipts' k, COUNT(*) v FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT store_key)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'mixed staff flag receipts', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores w/ >1 format', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'store 900 / 999 rows', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id>=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'null format current stores', COUNT(*) FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND format IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'closed/refit store rows in P4', COUNT(*) FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_end_date>=DATE '2026-08-03' AND closure_start_date<=DATE '2026-08-30'

calls.statement:
WITH a AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1),
b AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(receipts) receipts, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) net, COUNT(*) days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
 WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(a.store_id,b.store_id) id, a.receipts ar, b.receipts br, a.net, b.net bnet, a.days, b.days bd
FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.store_id=b.store_id
WHERE a.receipts IS DISTINCT FROM b.receipts OR abs(a.net-b.net)>0.5 OR a.days<>b.days
ORDER BY 1
